body:
I love combining Methylphenidate and Alprazolam. I usually have 30 mgs of Methylphenidate and 2 mgs of Alprazolam they seem to go hand in hand. The Alprazolam takes the edginess of the Methylphenidate away and they seem to boost the euphoria of each other and a little bit of cannabis in the mix is even better .the Alprazolam with the Cannabis and Methylphenidate it's super euphoric the Alprazolam takes the paranoia and anxiety from the Cannabis I will be left with a good euphoric combination. I have 30mgs Methylphenidate and 2mgs of Alprazolam and then they have kicked in than toke on a little bit of Cannabis.
